topic: ACR O-RADS Ultrasound Risk Stratification System

categories.name: O-RADS 0: Incomplete Evaluation
categories.criteria: Examination technically compromised due to severe bowel gas, morbid obesity, non-cooperation, or mass exceeding transvaginal field of view.
categories.management_premenopausal: Repeat ultrasound or perform pelvic MRI / transabdominal ultrasound with full bladder.
categories.management_postmenopausal: Repeat ultrasound or perform pelvic MRI.

categories.name: O-RADS 1: Normal Ovary
categories.criteria: Normal ovarian stroma with physiological simple follicle ≤ 30 mm or physiological corpus luteum ≤ 30 mm in premenopausal women.
categories.management_postmenopausal: Not applicable (Postmenopausal ovaries should not contain active follicles).

categories.name: O-RADS 2: Almost Certainly Benign

subtypes.name: Simple cyst
subtypes.criteria: Smooth thin wall, anechoic, no internal echoes/septa/solid tissue, ≤ 10 cm in premenopausal or ≤ 5 cm in postmenopausal women.

subtypes.name: Bilocular cyst
subtypes.criteria: Single thin smooth septum, no solid component, < 10 cm.

subtypes.name: Classic Dermoid / Mature Teratoma
subtypes.criteria: Echogenic focal nodule with acoustic shadowing (Rokitansky nodule), dermoid mesh (echogenic lines/dots), or fat-fluid level, < 10 cm, no vascularized solid tissue.

subtypes.name: Classic Endometrioma
subtypes.criteria: Homogeneous low-level ground-glass echoes, no vascularized solid component, < 10 cm.

subtypes.name: Classic Hemorrhagic Cyst
subtypes.criteria: Reticular lacy fishnet pattern or retracting non-vascularized clot, smooth wall, < 10 cm (premenopausal).

subtypes.name: Simple Paratubal / Inclusion Cyst
subtypes.criteria: Smooth thin-walled anechoic cyst separate from the ovary, any size.

categories.management_premenopausal: No follow-up for simple cysts ≤ 5 cm; follow-up ultrasound in 6-12 months for 5-10 cm simple cysts or classic benign lesions.
categories.management_postmenopausal: No follow-up for simple cysts ≤ 3 cm; follow-up ultrasound in 1 year for 3-5 cm cysts; pelvic MRI or gynecologist consult if > 5 cm.

categories.name: O-RADS 3: Low Risk of Malignancy

subtypes.name: Large Simple Cyst
subtypes.criteria: Simple cyst > 10 cm in premenopausal or 5-10 cm in postmenopausal women.

subtypes.name: Multilocular Cyst < 10 cm
subtypes.criteria: Smooth inner walls/septa, no solid components, Color Score 1-3.

subtypes.name: Atypical Dermoid / Endometrioma / Hemorrhagic Cyst
subtypes.criteria: Mass ≥ 10 cm without internal vascularized solid component.

subtypes.name: Solid Mass with Smooth Contour and Shadowing
subtypes.criteria: Any size solid lesion with smooth contour demonstrating distinct acoustic shadowing, Color Score 1-2 (Typical fibroma/thecoma/Brenner tumor).

categories.management_premenopausal: Management by general gynecologist. Ultrasound follow-up in 3-6 months or surgical excision depending on symptoms.
categories.management_postmenopausal: Management by gynecologist. Pelvic MRI or surgical consult.

categories.name: O-RADS 4: Intermediate Risk of Malignancy

subtypes.name: Multilocular Cyst ≥ 10 cm
subtypes.criteria: Smooth inner walls and septa without solid components, but largest diameter ≥ 10 cm.

subtypes.name: Multilocular Cyst with Irregular Wall
subtypes.criteria: Irregular septa or wall thickening < 3 mm, Color Score 1-3.

subtypes.name: Unilocular or Multilocular Cyst with Solid Component
subtypes.criteria: Cyst with 1-3 papillary projections (height ≥ 3 mm) or non-shadowing solid component, Color Score 1-2.

subtypes.name: Solid Mass without Shadowing
subtypes.criteria: Smooth contour solid mass without shadowing, Color Score 1-2.

categories.management_premenopausal: Referral to Gynecologic Oncologist or consultation with specialized Gynecologist. Pelvic MRI with contrast recommended for characterization.
categories.management_postmenopausal: Referral to Gynecologic Oncologist. Pelvic MRI with contrast strongly recommended.

categories.name: O-RADS 5: High Risk of Malignancy

subtypes.name: Solid Mass with Irregular Contour
subtypes.criteria: Solid mass with irregular/lobulated contour and Color Score 1-4.

subtypes.name: Solid Mass with Abundant Blood Flow
subtypes.criteria: Solid mass with Color Score 4 (chaotic strong vascularity), regardless of contour.

subtypes.name: Multilocular-Solid with High Papillary Count
subtypes.criteria: Multilocular cyst with ≥ 4 papillary projections or extensive solid tissue, Color Score 3-4.

subtypes.name: Presence of Ascites or Peritoneal Nodules
subtypes.criteria: Any adnexal mass with ascites (fluid outside pelvis) or nodular peritoneal carcinomatosis.

categories.management_premenopausal: Immediate referral to Gynecologic Oncologist for staging and multidisciplinary surgical planning.
categories.management_postmenopausal: Immediate referral to Gynecologic Oncologist for surgical oncological intervention.
